description_en: Queries a list of backup jobs
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb list-backup-jobs --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --backup-mode Automated --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListBackupJobs

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

Automated
Manual

If you do not specify this parameter, all backup sets are returned
parameters.help_zh:
备份模式。取值说明：

Automated：系统自动备份。
Manual：手动备份。

如果不传，则返回所有
parameters.name: backup_mode

BackupMode.description_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

Automated
Manual
BackupMode.description_zh:
备份模式。取值说明：
Automated：系统自动备份

BackupStatus.description_en:
The backup status. Valid values:

Success

BackupStatus.description_zh:
备份集状态。取值说明：

Success：成功。
Failure：失败

Process.description_en: The progress of the backup job

StartTime.description_en: The time when the backup job started. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 备份任务开始时间（UTC），格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
